_comment: The committed dead-territory list of the hypothesis-authoring agent.
app_spec.xml, Hypothesis Authoring Agent, feature 213:
System rejects any root opening in structurally dead territory such as
sub-30-minute liquidity-taking strategies.
docs/alpha-engine-prd.md 9.4 ('What is structurally dead at retail
scale') is where this list comes from and why it is committed rather than
computed: 'Triangular arbitrage, cross-exchange latency arbitrage,
anything with a holding period under ~30 minutes taking liquidity. Do not
let the agent open roots there.'  These three are the initial denylist;
each entry below carries that section's name for it verbatim as its
title, so the document and the PRD can be diffed against each other by
eye.
This is the NEIGHBOURING refusal feature 212's legal theme set is not:
feature 212's legal_themes.json is an ALLOWLIST - a root is admitted iff
the human admitted the space (PRD 9.3) - while this list is a DENYLIST -
a root is refused iff it is a mechanism 9.4 names as dead.  A root can be
legal (in the 9.3 set) and yet dead (a 9.4 mechanism), and the two gates
are independent: the pipeline judges 212 (is the space admitted?) then
213 (is the mechanism live?).  A document that folded them together would
make the second unfixable without widening the first.
The compile in packages/signal-agent/src/signal_agent/_dead_territory.py
refuses this file and any change to it that is not a marker plus a list
of well-formed slug/title entries - so the list below is not a convention
the next edit can forget: it is the configuration, checked, and a
proposal opening in a mechanism it names is refused with the code
dead_territory.  An empty list is refused by the compile (the absence of
9.4's decision); the builder fails OPEN to an empty denylist only when
this file cannot be read, because a down guardrail refuses fewer
proposals than a system that refuses them all.
The slugs are the machine spelling the node table's theme_root column
holds (docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md 9.1: 'theme_root TEXT NOT
NULL'); the titles are for the human reading a rejection.  Widening this
list (adding a mechanism a later finding proved dead) is widening the
denylist, which PRD 9 makes the human's own decision - the widen happens
here, in review, or not at all.

mechanisms.title: Anything with a holding period under ~30 minutes taking liquidity
